title: Ripple
subtitle: When one source changes, know which decisions to revisit.

slides.title: Research outlives its sources
bullets: A technical integration plan depends on changing documentation.
Create a board from your own question, requirements and public URLs.
slides.notes: Compact web application, deployed at https://searchhack-ripple-08a1a865.vercel.app (controller deployment of commit 3eb7c5c).

slides.title: Sources → facts → decisions
bullets: Telem qualifies selected URLs; direct Tavily basic extraction supplies their evidence text.
Literal quotes, observation timestamps and model-proposed dependency edges.
Failed or partial evidence keeps dependent freshness unknown.
Extractor, provider request ID, batch usage and partial or error evidence stay visible; two reads of one URL are one source.
slides.notes: Quote presence is not truth. Dependencies are model-proposed.

slides.title: A requirement edit has a visible boundary
bullets: HTTPS browser recheck: 2 pages, 9 quoted facts, 5 answers.
Requirement text three → eight: 0 source reads, 1 answer recomputed, 4 reused.
Unchanged source refresh: 2 pages checked, 0 recomputed, 5 reused.
slides.notes: Observed through the supplied Playwright MCP on deployment 3eb7c5c during R01 (demo/R01-release-verification.json). This is a browser recheck, not the final recording. Model output can vary; provider cache age and refresh savings are not measured.

slides.title: Measure work, preserve uncertainty
bullets: Live evaluator: 3/3 selected cases (LIVE01–03). Fixture evaluator: 10/10 treatment cases.
Refresh-all has 6 expected recomputation-set mismatches on fixture cases.
Refresh savings and total provider-work savings: not measured.
slides.notes: From demo/L02-verification.json. Cold and warm caches make latency not comparable. Fixture cases are synthetic, not live website changes.

slides.title: Carry the evidence forward
bullets: Browser IndexedDB library, immutable revisions and explicit export and import.
Local stdio agent kit: same service and quotas, separate local vault.
No background monitoring, cloud sync or proven complete dependency discovery.
slides.notes: The independent public-beta HTTPS gate passed against deployment 3eb7c5c. The first MCP gate failed QUOTA_EXCEEDED; the targeted R01 rerun of the unchanged supplied gate passed 12/12 on that same deployment (demo/R01-mcp-gate.json). Final controller release gates and HTTPS media remain pending. The failed HTTPS capture has no completed video/screenshots; draft slides have no unresolved text. Earlier localhost media is complete. public_ready=false; native Claude/Codex invocation is unverified.

slides.title: Both providers, observed locally
bullets: Local two-domain API flows (TV01) ran actual Telem, Tavily, model and shared Redis calls.
Local sponsor observer: 6/6, with live=false and sponsors_ready=false.
That run: Telem 3 HTTP attempts, direct Tavily 2, 1 credit reported for create.
Reported credits are usage returned by the provider, not a balance or a free-use promise.
slides.notes: Not the deployed sponsor gate. Provider cache age and redirect chains are not independently established. Records: demo/TV01-verification.json and handoffs/TV02.md.
